answer: Because the timing is recorded against the pearl challenge, the lotus audit can replay the atlas history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm as a result has to pad 30 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which burns the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 3 times over for the same share of the pool. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
